summary: Elatus was a centaur wounded during Heracles' pursuit of the wild centaurs after the riot at Pholus' cave. An arrow poisoned with Hydra venom passed through Elatus' arm and struck Chiron in the knee, leading indirectly to Chiron's death.

sections.heading: Mythology
paragraphs: At Malea the centaurs took refuge with Chiron; Heracles' arrow pierced Elatus' arm and lodged in Chiron's knee.
Distinct from Elatus the Arcadian, son of Arcas.
